summary: Focused verification of the user-reported 'app not loading' bug fix for the QuickWish Vendor PWA. All 5 target checks PASSED: preview URL serves the Vite PWA (not Expo/Metro/'Please wait, Your app is brewing'), mobile (390x844) login->dashboard flow works with phone 9999999999/OTP 123456, mobile hamburger menu opens sidebar and Orders/Products/Discounts/Profile routes render, PWA installability signals present (theme-color=#002FA7, /manifest.webmanifest 200, /icon-192.png 200), and after 'sudo supervisorctl restart expo vendor-pwa' both stay RUNNING with the PWA continuing to serve on port 3000 (expo stub does not steal the port). Backend healthy through the preview URL (POST /api/auth/send-otp -> 200 with debug_otp=123456).
critical_code_review_comments: Fix verified as robust: neutralizing /app/frontend/node_modules/.bin/expo to a sleep-infinity stub cleanly prevents the 'expo' supervisor program from racing/binding port 3000, so 'vendor-pwa' reliably owns 3000 across restarts. Recommended follow-up (not blocking): consider also removing the 'expo' supervisor program entry entirely since the project is web-only now — a stub process is harmless but adds noise.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for 'Please wait, Your app is brewing' (Expo preview flow) is verified complete on the web preview URL path. The Emergent in-platform 'Preview in Expo' mobile QR flow itself is a platform limitation for this converted project and is out of scope. The web PWA at https://vendor-dashboard-app-2.preview.emergentagent.com/ is the correct access path and works on mobile viewport. Full feature regression already covered in iterations 19 & 20 (100% backend). Only revisit this bug if the user reports the URL again showing blank/Expo screen.
rca of the issue: Original cause: project was created as Mobile/Expo. During conversion to web PWA (Vite at /app/vendor-pwa on port 3000), the leftover 'expo' supervisor program plus the /app/frontend expo CLI could restart and bind :3000, causing the Emergent preview to return an Expo/Metro 'brewing' screen. Reproduction: user opens preview URL on phone after a pod restart -> sees brewing screen forever. Mitigation applied by main agent: (a) vendor-pwa supervisor program owns :3000 with yarn dev; (b) /app/frontend/node_modules/.bin/expo replaced with 'sleep infinity' stub so supervisor 'expo' program cannot spawn a real expo dev server. Verified: after 'sudo supervisorctl restart expo vendor-pwa', both stay RUNNING and preview URL still returns the QuickWish Vendor Vite HTML with <div id=root>, no 'Please wait / Metro / Expo Go' tokens present.
